en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a low-rise city with gridded streets and many detached houses surrounded by trees. In the foreground, within a wooded park, stand several large, multi‑storey stone institutional buildings arranged around open lawns; some appear partially ruined or roofless. Beyond the city is a broad flat plain leading to a large body of water (possibly a lake or bay) with mountains visible on the far horizon. A thin white border frames the image, and at the lower right there is a faint, handwritten caption that appears mirrored and partly illegible.
